purpose: Establish what is already known about daily crypto returns before any economic-function test: the market factor, momentum, and volatility. Function sorts on the six verified assets are a descriptive preview, not a test.

function_sorts.common_window_rule: Start on the first date every listed asset has a return; end on the last common date.

selection_rule: Predictors and sort variables are listed before estimation; no factor or bundle was chosen from return outcomes.
interpretation: Baseline exposures and descriptive sorts. Six-asset sorts cannot support inference about economic functions; they show what the classification would be tested on once the remaining universe is verified.
